text:
alec: Quick sync — from INC-834 postmortem: need to lock owners for the outstanding action items and confirm staggered cutover dates. Also need a short SLA impact blurb for the customer timeline. Spreadsheet: https://docs.internal/redwood/inc834-actions

marta: I can take item A (alerts tuning + threshold adjustments). Target Nov 03 EOD. Will update the sheet. :thumbsup:

sri: I'll own item B (KV cache invalidation + safe-rebuild). Target Nov 06 AM. Need a tiny schema PR for the new cache_version column — @kevin can you review?

kevin: @sri yep I can review. Ping me once PR is up. Suggest adding a 5% canary step to the rollout (monitor error_rate + p95). :eyes:

deploy-bot: canary-plan suggestion added to deploy doc: window=60m, step=5%, monitor_metrics=[error_rate,p95_latency], rollback_on=error_rate>0.3%

jen: For the SLA blurb — are we documenting latency degradation only, or do we need to call out dropped requests/504s?

sri: Mostly latency spikes and a small fraction of 504s for certain KV keys. I'll attach sample logs and a short impact summary to the sheet.

dave: I'll take item C (model fallback policy + automated rollback). ETA Nov 08. Will need a quick vet from eng-platform — @marta can we do a 15m sync tomorrow?

marta: 10:00am PT tomorrow works for me. I'll send an invite.

alec: Great — summarizing assignments so we have a single place to reference: A -> marta (2026-11-03), B -> sri (2026-11-06), C -> dave (2026-11-08). Action notes: @kevin review PR for B, @jen draft SLA blurb by EOD, deploy-bot will add canary steps to runbook. I'll update the RCA doc and customer timeline after Jen posts the blurb.

jen: On it — drafting now, will paste final wording in the doc by EOD. :wave:

kevin: PR review plan: if @sri's PR has only the schema change and tests pass, I'll merge and kick a canary deploy. If CI flakes, I'll push the small fix and rerun.

sri: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/7234 — includes schema change: ```ALTER TABLE kv ADD COLUMN cache_version INT DEFAULT 1;``` + migration test. @kevin PTAL.

kevin: LGTM aside from a flaky test in CI (timeout on test_kv_rebuild). I'll patch and merge later today. :thumbsup:

alec: Added a short SLA impact note to the customer-facing incident timeline and linked the action spreadsheet. @customer-success FYI — please review the customer blurb once Jen posts it.

customer-success: Thanks — will review the SLA wording when Jen posts. If we need an exec note, flag it here.

alec: Closing this ownership confirmation thread for now. If anyone needs slips or reassigns, reply here and I'll reopen the tracker. :ok_hand:
